strategy.mode: metadata-first, deterministic, OpenAIRE-aligned export plus richer internal JSON
strategy.title_policy: Single export title only. Multilingual or alternative titles are preserved in internal.title_variants.
strategy.language_policy: dc:language is treated as the resource language. Multilingual metadata literal languages are tracked separately in internal.metadata_languages.
strategy.dates_policy: Export dates are limited to Accepted, Available, Issued. Available falls back to Issued when absent. Submitted, Created and Modified stay in internal.internal_dates.
strategy.alternate_identifier_policy: Internal article IDs are not exported as OpenAIRE alternateIdentifiers; they are preserved only in internal.article_ID/object_ID.
strategy.description_policy: Preserve multilingual DC.Description entries when present.
strategy.files_policy: citation_pdf_url is preferred for oaire:file/fulltext extraction; viewer URLs are deterministically converted to download URLs for internal PDF assets and local PDF saving.
strategy.references_policy: All citation_reference values are preserved as supplemental data; no promotion to OpenAIRE relatedIdentifier.
strategy.warning_diagnostics_policy: If enabled, warnings can trigger an advisory OpenAI call with automatic second attempt and user-controlled further retry loop; AI output is supplemental and never mutates extracted metadata automatically.

title.datacite:title: Il tutor esterno nei PCTO (Percorsi per le Competenze Trasversali e l’Orientamento): maestro invisibile alla ricerca di circolarità fra teoria e prassi

descriptions.value: This contribution aims to bring the attention to the issue of the role of enterprise tutors and their recognition as educational agents within the broader discourse on work-related learning places. Through shadowing and in-depth interviews, the study examined the experiences of the tutors regarding the co-construction of learning spaces and educational design, as well as the requests for qualification and participation.

Questo contributo affronta la questione del ruolo dei tutor1 d’azienda e del loro riconoscimento come agenti formativi all’interno del più ampio discorso sui luoghi di apprendimento work-related.Attraverso la tecnica dello shadowing e interviste in profondità si è cercato di comprendere le esperienze dei tutor aziendali in riferimento alla co-costruzione di spazi di apprendimento e di progettazione educativa e alle richieste di qualificazione e partecipazione.
